name: Octree-based AMR Data Splitting
definition: A method to split hierarchical AMR data into uniform blocks by overlaying the data domain with an octree aligned with the finest grid cells, allowing each leaf to correspond to a uniform rectilinear grid of data values.
summary: Octree-based AMR Data Splitting partitions hierarchical AMR data into uniform rectilinear blocks by overlaying an octree aligned to the finest grid resolution, converting unstructured elements into uniform grids.
